cohort: The study included 210 antenatal females registered at an Urban Health and Training Center (UHTC).
finding: A significant proportion of antenatal women (61.9%) had insufficient vitamin D levels.
mod_finding: The study reported that 56 out of 210 participants had a Lower Segment Cesarean Section (LSCS) as the mode of delivery, and 154 had a vaginal delivery.
cross-section timing: Data collection occurred over a four-month duration during the antenatal period.
